open.ping.description: Signature self-check: once the signature verifies, returns the AppKey, the credential owner and the server time. Callable only with requests signed by an open API credential (X-Access-Key, X-Timestamp, X-Nonce, X-Content-Sign, X-Signature).
open.echo.description: Echo: returns the request body as received, to check the content signature and encryption (the body may be AES-CBC encrypted, and the response is then encrypted too). Signed calls only.
openplatform.signing.timestamp_expired: The request is outside the time window (more than {seconds} seconds from the server time).
openplatform.signing.access_key_invalid: The AccessKey is invalid or disabled.
openplatform.signing.ip_not_allowed: The request IP is not on the allow-list: {ip}.
openplatform.signing.content_sign_mismat: The content signature does not match.
openplatform.signing.signature_mismatch: The request signature does not match.
openplatform.signing.algorithm_mismatch: Signature algorithm {value} does not match the configured {expected}.
openplatform.signing.body_too_large: The request body exceeds the limit ({max} bytes).
openplatform.signing.body_decrypt_failed: The request body could not be decrypted.
oauth_apps.list.description: List OAuth apps (created by the platform or by users under My apps) page by page; the keyword matches name, description, ClientId, homepage and remark, with filters for app type, client type, enabled, skip consent and personal apps. Requires openplatform.oauth-apps.read.
oauth_apps.get.description: Get one OAuth app (the secret is never shown). Requires openplatform.oauth-apps.read.
oauth_apps.create.description: Create an OAuth app: the ClientId is generated when omitted and is globally unique; a confidential client’s secret is returned this once only, a public client has none (its authorization codes need PKCE). Requires openplatform.oauth-apps.create.
oauth_apps.update.description: Update an OAuth app (replaced as a whole, including enabled; the ClientId, client type and secret stay). Requires openplatform.oauth-apps.update.
oauth_apps.reset_secret.description: Reset an OAuth app’s secret: the old secret stops working at once and the new one is returned this once only; public clients have no secret. Requires openplatform.oauth-apps.update.
oauth_apps.delete.description: Delete OAuth apps in bulk (soft delete; tokens issued to them stop working with them). Requires openplatform.oauth-apps.delete.
my_oauth_apps.list.description: List your own OAuth apps. Requires sign-in only.
my_oauth_apps.get.description: Get one of your OAuth apps. Requires sign-in only.
my_oauth_apps.create.description: Create one of your OAuth apps (authorization code and refresh token, scopes openid profile email, consent required); a confidential client’s secret is returned this once only. Not available in impersonation sessions.
my_oauth_apps.update.description: Update one of your OAuth apps: name, homepage, description, redirect URIs, logo and enabled. Not available in impersonation sessions.
my_oauth_apps.reset_secret.description: Reset the secret of one of your OAuth apps (public clients have none). Not available in impersonation sessions.
my_oauth_apps.delete.description: Delete your OAuth apps. Not available in impersonation sessions.
openplatform.query.filter_unsupported: Filtering by {field} with {operator} is not supported.
openplatform.oauth_apps.not_found: The OAuth app does not exist.
openplatform.oauth_apps.public_client_no: Public clients do not use a secret, so it cannot be reset.
openplatform.oauth_apps.client_id_invali: The ClientId must be 3 to 100 letters, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens: {value}.
openplatform.oauth_apps.grant_type_unsup: Unsupported grant type: {value} (authorization_code is required, refresh_token is optional).
openplatform.oauth_apps.scope_unsupporte: Unsupported scope: {value} (openid is required; profile, email and phone are optional).
openplatform.oauth_apps.redirect_uri_inv: Invalid redirect URI: {value} (1 to 10 absolute URIs without #; http only for loopback).
openplatform.oauth_apps.url_invalid: The URL must be http or https: {value}.
